objective: Implement PRD-defined input ingestion, attribution, normalization, redaction, persistence, and provenance capture.
implemented_behaviors: Plural secret-named fields such as metadata.secrets, tokens, passwords, api_keys, access_tokens, refresh_tokens, private_keys, and client_secrets are redacted before persistence.

Hash-like fields no longer bypass entropy scanning by key name alone; commit, signature, digest, checksum, and fingerprint fields are entropy-exempt only when their values match expected hash or fingerprint formats.
Malformed high-entropy values in action.commit fail closed with exit 6 before any .relia/experiences shard is written.
Existing canonical ingest, provenance, idempotent upsert, and fail-closed redaction behaviors remain covered by the full prepush validation lane.

findings.finding: Validate hashes before skipping entropy scans
